clarifications: Eight CMSY script-letter glyph classes receive one observed Unicode glyph each only in calibrated_selected.
The mapsto glyph is visibly a vertical bar with a short right stem. Its three occurrences receive U+22A2 only in calibrated_selected; separate arrow pieces are not merged.
Ligatures, already-visible mathematical signs and ordinary decoded whitespace retain their literal extraction unless explicitly listed in glyph_aliases.json.
All Type0 dictionaries retain literal returned extraction. No source font or glyph image is exported.

extraction_limits: Generated line breaks remain distinct from actual glyph events. No form callback duplication occurs in these six PDFs.
Footer cuts are limited to the isolated physical page number at the end of every page and apply only to selected variants.
NFC and NFKC sensitivities do not remove mathematical or program text.
Ghostscript emitted font-cache warnings during rendering; embedded glyph outlines were still inspected. This record makes no claim of a warning-free Ghostscript run.
reader_visual_findings: Both pages viewed. Final acceptance-binding sentence on page1 re-rendered and viewed; page2 extracted text unchanged. Tables and prose fit; no clipping, missing symbols or overlap. Final second XeLaTeX run has no missing/overfull/warning diagnostics.
